items.title: Nvidia, Micron, DJT, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, Plug Power, Fermi, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: The chip maker’s plan to line up $500 billion in financing for its customers is getting a tentative thumbs-up from shareholders, including Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest which is scooping up shares.  Micron Technology  gained 0.6% to $865.94.  The stock has declined 12% over the past month and well short of its peak of more than $1,200 reached in late June on concerns about the sustainability of sky-high margins in a typically cyclical business.
